conclusion: No exact original source evidence presently supports changing virtual-device metadata or permissions. App-local touch success does not prove system-edge eligibility. Native worker independently traces Setup completion and SpringBoard state; active assertion/gesture-recognizer state is the next discriminating boundary.
limits: No claim that Home gesture actually reached recognizer, no claim original OS rejects virtual input, and no bypass proposed.

main_digitizer_selection.bounded_diagnostic: Inspect actual owned IOHIDEventDriver child registryID, Built-In boolean, PrimaryUsagePage/PrimaryUsage and DisplayIntegrated, plus competing registered digitizer event services. Original HBPP bootloader being present does not itself prove it registered an IOHIDEventService or captured the slot. Original acquisition logs can distinguish matching where available.
main_digitizer_selection.limit: These fields do not expose private backboard main-slot contents by themselves, and selection does not prove every system-edge gesture uses this one service. No property change authorized by this finding.
